import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Get target column and feature columns
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in [id_col, target_col]]

# Ensure all features exist in both train and test
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

# Handle any missing values by dropping rows/cols
X_train = X_train.dropna(axis=1).dropna(axis=0)
X_test = X_test.dropna(axis=1).dropna(axis=0)

# Convert target to integer for model compatibility
y_train = train_df[target_col]
y_train_int = y_train.astype(int)

# Split into training/validation sets WITHOUT stratification (handles rare classes)
X_train_val, X_val, y_train_val, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train_int, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Initialize multiple LightGBM models for ensemble
model_configs = [
    {
        "n_estimators": 200,
        "max_depth": 8,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
        "min_child_samples": 20,
        "reg_alpha": 0.1,
        "reg_lambda": 0.1,
        "random_state": i,
        "verbose": -1,
    }
    for i in range(5)
]

# Train ensemble of models
ensemble_preds = []
for idx, config in enumerate(model_configs):
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**config)
    model.fit(X_train_val, y_train_val)
    ensemble_preds.append(model.predict(X_val))
    print(
        f"Model {idx+1} val accuracy: {accuracy_score(y_val, ensemble_preds[-1]):.4f}"
    )

# Average predictions from ensemble
final_predictions_val = np.mean(ensemble_preds, axis=0)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, final_predictions_val)
print(f"Hold-out Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Predict on full test set with ensemble
ensemble_preds_test = []
for config in model_configs:
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(random_state=config["random_state"], verbose=-1)
    model.fit(X_train_val, y_train_val)
    ensemble_preds_test.append(model.predict(X_test))

final_predictions_test = np.mean(ensemble_preds_test, axis=0)

# Create submission dataframe matching sample format
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

if isinstance(final_predictions_test, np.ndarray):
    final_predictions_test = final_predictions_test.astype(int)

submission = pd.DataFrame({id_col: test_df[id_col], target_col: final_predictions_test})

# Save submission file
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
